selectedProject.name: Hermes Agentic Workflow
selectedProject.nextAction: Define the first safe agentic execution loop: plan, patch, test, report, and require approval before merge.

approval.reason: Approve constrained patch application for Hermes Agentic Patch Apply v3. No push or merge is authorized.

notes: This is the first constrained Hermes agentic patch application.
It writes one approved repo-local artifact, captures a diff, runs validations, and stops before push or merge.
The next version can add branch creation and PR draft generation after this pattern is stable.
